This is a real Opalix lab container.

This page is served by python3 -m http.server, running inside a Cloudflare Container claimed for this session, proxied through the Opalix sandbox Worker to your browser.

The task for this lab: write the value of the GREETING environment variable to /workspace/greeting.txt.

  • Attach a terminal with the CLI: opalix session attach
  • Run the checker: opalix session check
